event: 2013-04-11 SEP event (CME first in LASCO/C2 07:24 UT, AR 11719, N09E12)

decisions.note: Every physical choice below was made explicitly by the user (2026-11-24/25); see README.md, section 'Decisions'.
decisions.shock_kinematics: heliocentric (Sun-centred) spherical front r_sh(t), data-driven monotone PCHIP through Lario et al. (2014) Table 2 heights above the L1 footpoint and the Wind in-situ shock (CfA database)
decisions.solar_wind: isothermal Parker (1958) transonic wind with one sound speed fitted so U(L1) equals the OMNI speed; density from mass flux normalized to the OMNI electron density; below 2.5 Rs the same isothermal wind flows along each open PFSS tube (corotating-frame field-aligned flow, rho u/|B| constant, isothermal Bernoulli); ambient window 2013-04-11 00:55-06:55 UT
decisions.thermodynamic_closure: measured L1 T_e, T_p, T_alpha (Wind/SWE h5, OMNI, Wind/SWE h1 quality-10 fits with W=sqrt(2kT/M)) constant with radius; they set pressure and every Rankine-Hugoniot/characteristic speed
decisions.compression_cap: none (reduced core local Rankine-Hugoniot compression, no cap)
decisions.source_energy_note: User decision 2026-11-25 ('use ... 20 keV'): the lower bound was raised from 0.01 MeV because a 10 keV proton (1384 km/s) cannot outrun the 1459 km/s shock at t0 (README.md, section 3).
decisions.release_distance_note: User decision 2026-11-25 ('use f = 0.3'): L_ref = f R_sh(t); see README.md, section 2.
decisions.lambda_parallel: Liu et al. (2025) Eqs. 14-16: 0.3 AU (r/AU) (pc/1 GeV)^(1/3), shared by all movers
decisions.amplitude: one global factor calibrated on the SOHO/ERNE HED 4 h window; everything else held out
decisions.nightly_gate: DiffNum.pl against AMPS references only; the observation score is reported, not gating
decisions.observation_windows: re-averaged on the model's output grid
decisions.erne_channels: revised f50 bounds (University of Turku export description, section 7.2)
decisions.erne_quality: PH1-PH2 all minutes; PH3-PH10 only minutes with status bit b12 (HED HIT 3x) clear, per note (2) of section 7.2
decisions.magnetic_field: WSO radial-model PFSS coefficients (CR2135, independent of Rss), source surface at 2.5 Rs (WSO standard; the PFSS footpoint method of Lario et al. 2014), one amplitude calibrated to the OMNI |B| at L1 at t0
decisions.corotation_drift: accepted (user, 2026-11-24): the material line corotates with the Sun while Earth does not; the Earth-to-line longitude offset is reported per comparison window
decisions.transport_path: shared reduced shock-front core (src/models/sep_corona_swcme/shock_front, schema v1.3) through srcSEP --reduced-shock-event
decisions.field_line: the core field line through Earth at t0, traced by srcSEP from Earth sunward to the 1.1 Rs base (open PFSS tube below 2.5 Rs, Parker spiral above)

clocks.comparison_reference_note: Liu et al. (2025) Figure 12 elapsed-hour origin (first LASCO/C2 appearance); the ERNE windows are centred 4, 12 and 36 h after it
clocks.ambient_window_note: half-open on the 1-min sample start; flare soft X-ray onset 06:55 UT (Lario et al. 2014 Section 2)
clocks.run_end_note: GOES-13 >10 MeV event end from the CCMC/OpSEP record; also covers the 36 h ERNE window

source.nominal_injection_efficiency_note: Placeholder scale only. The physical amplitude is the single global factor fitted to the ERNE 4 h calibration window; the effective efficiency (factor x nominal) is reported with the score.
source.release_distance_note: User decision 2026-11-25. L_ref = f R_sh(t): particles are released where the field line crosses the Sun-centred sphere of radius (1+f) R_sh(t). f = 0.3 lies inside the published free-escape-boundary fractions (0.17 Wijsen et al. 2022 and 0.23 Afanasiev et al. 2025 near 1 au; 0.5 Afanasiev et al. 2015 at 2 Rs) and keeps the 1 au observers outside the release sphere until the end of the particle run (README.md, section 2).

liu_holdout.minimum_energy_note: XM03/OV01 scoring rule: ACE/EPAM below 1 MeV is ion-contaminated (Liu et al. 2025)

numerics.output_cadence_note: fixed in srcSEP/sampling.cpp; recorded so the observation windows can be checked against it
numerics.note: Numerical values are provisional until the convergence study in README.md is complete.
numerics.pfss_trace_step_note: radius step of the core's v1.3 open-tube foot trace; the mass flux per unit flux it gives agrees with the 1e6 m arc-length trace to <1e-8 (HSP12)
numerics.relative_segment_length_note: geometric line spacing with chord ~ eps*r everywhere (first chord eps*r_base, growth 1+eps): lambda_par and the focusing length both scale with r; PROVISIONAL until the convergence study
numerics.field_line_point_count_note: derived by prepare_event.py from relative_segment_length and the line length
numerics.shock_boundary_note: --shock-boundary-root-table on and --shock-boundary-tolerance-m: the verified piecewise-linear shock-root table and its boundary tolerance (the 1 m default forces sub-0.1 s substeps during the early shock deceleration); PROVISIONAL until the convergence study

nightly.note: Nightly tier (user decisions 2026-11-25: short coarse nightly run of all three movers, the full event as a separate long test; inner observers added; 60 steps). event.nightly.in = event.in with only these values changed. The grid and the samples per step are PROVISIONAL until the convergence study.
nightly.time_steps_note: User decision 2026-11-25 ('60 step'). 60 steps of 60 s = the first hour: the shock goes from 2.52 to 7.4 Rs through its strong and weak phases, and the source particles fill the line out to about 1 AU (FTE-MFP run of the nightly deck, 2026-11-25)
nightly.inner_observer_note: regression-only broadband observers (source band, logarithmic bins, 24 pitch-angle bins); outside the release sphere 1.3 R_sh, which is at 0.045 au after one hour; not compared with observations
